title: WRCC2023_MI_C: Three-class motor imagery dataset from the World Robot Contest 2023 (MI-C)
description: Three-class motor imagery EEG dataset (left hand, right hand, feet) from the MI-C track of the 2023 World Robot Contest BCI competition. It includes 8 participants, two of whom are stroke patients, with 90 cue-based trials each recorded from 59 EEG channels at 1000 Hz. This BIDS release was reformatted from the original Harvard Dataverse deposit using MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuracle NeuSen W 64-channel wireless system (59 EEG channels used, 1000 Hz sampling rate, standard_1005 montage). Participants performed cue-based offline motor imagery of left hand, right hand, or feet, with 30 trials per class and 4-second trials. Each trial is stored as a separate run.
